title: evil-10 port theft
description: Red-team napplet: attacks the post-#14 port lifecycle itself — scans for a reachable private port, proves the cross-frame transfer primitive, then detonates the full chain: steal the shell's bound port into a sibling frame, speak as the verified napplet from there, self-revoke, and test whether the channel (and the grants) survive the napplet's own destruction.
